Name: HiddenSpikeTrap's Portrait Mod - Sebastian
Author: Awesomecupcakes
Description:
Been wanting to do my own version of the character portraits, so Sebastian is the first! This is my first time doing something like this, so if I messed something up, let me know!

I hope to at least do the 10 bachelors and bachelorettes, but I may be rather slow, we'll see!

How to install this mod:
1. Download xnb file
2. Copy file xnb to your Path *\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits\ (should backup old file if you want)
3. Enjoy the game!
